order: Close the probe/redraw cycle with a final ruling applied to the plan. Merge the two investigator classes into a single class — identical castings at every rung, a five-entry ledger, and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake — keeping the retired class name only as an alias; no other classes may be merged, so the taxonomy holds at exactly twenty-three classes. Add a new decision procedure: seven fixed-order steps where the first match decides, and free entry into the later discriminator set must never reopen once closed. Amend exactly three named discriminators and retire exactly one; do not touch any discriminator outside that set. Reframe classification as a routing hypothesis tied to risk tier plus author family; restate the downstream gate as misroute recovery and rewrite the next work order to validate through the router. Unblock the previously gated work order and close the outstanding pair ledger with dispositions recorded.
claims: The two investigator classes were merged into one, holding the taxonomy at exactly twenty-three classes with the retired name kept only as an alias; read-only-first ordering was internalized and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake. A new decision procedure of seven fixed-order steps was added, with exactly three discriminators amended and exactly one retired. Classification was reframed as a routing hypothesis tied to risk tier and author family. The change touched three files with 384 insertions and 142 deletions, and the gated work order was unblocked, with the pair ledger closed.
